welcome_page.title: Car – Comfort
welcome_page.description:
Comfort, delays, parking and your surroundings when you travel by car.

Taking part is voluntary and you can skip any question. Your answers are not linked to your name. Giving your email is optional; the SmartUrbanity privacy notice explains how it is protected and how answers are used.

Learn more about SmartUrbanity

final_page.title: Thank you!
final_page.description: Your submission has been recorded. Thank you for taking the time to complete the questionnaire.

questions.text: Compared with other ways of getting around, how comfortable is the car for you?
When you are held up on a car trip, how stressed do you feel?
questions.help: For example traffic jams, crashes or roadworks.

questions.text: And how much do these delays upset your plans for the day?
Do traffic jams make you change your route or the time you leave?

options.text: Always: I plan my trips to avoid them

questions.text: How hard is it to find a parking space where you go?
questions.help: Think of the places you drive to most often.

options.text: Not for me: I don't drive

questions.text: When parking is hard, what do you usually do?

options.text: I still go, but it's slower or more stressful
I change my route or where I go
I put off, avoid or cancel some trips
I go another way instead (e.g. bus, on foot)

questions.text: How much do charging points affect whether you use an electric car?

options.text: Not for me: my vehicle isn't electric

questions.text: When you travel by car, how much does traffic noise bother or annoy you?
When you travel by car, what do you do when the air is bad (exhaust fumes, dust, bad smells)?

options.text: I notice it, but I don't change anything
I protect myself, e.g. with a mask or closed windows
I take another route or travel at another time
I travel another way (e.g. by bus instead of on foot)

questions.text: When you travel by car, what do you usually do when the weather is bad (rain, wind, cold or great heat)?

options.text: Nothing changes, I travel as usual
It's less pleasant, but I travel the same way
I prepare differently or change route (e.g. clothes, umbrella)
I put off or skip some trips
I travel another way (e.g. by car or bus)

questions.text: When you travel by car, what do you do when streets, stops or paths are dirty or badly kept (litter, smells, broken glass)?

options.text: I notice it, but carry on as usual
It's unpleasant, but I still go that way
I avoid some stops or stretches
I stop using that route altogether

questions.text: When you travel by car, do pleasant or unpleasant surroundings affect how you feel?
questions.help: For example buildings, squares, how cared-for a place is and its general feel.

options.text: No, I don't pay attention to them
I notice them, but they rarely make a difference
They affect a lot how I feel on the way
I sometimes choose a route because it's nicer or more interesting

it.#Compared with other ways of getting aro: Rispetto agli altri modi di spostarsi, quanto è comoda per te l'auto?
it.#When you are held up on a car trip, how: Quando resti bloccato o in ritardo in un viaggio in auto, quanto ti senti stressato?
it.#For example traffic jams, crashes or ro: Per esempio code, scontri o lavori in corso.
it.#And how much do these delays upset your: E quanto questi ritardi scombinano i tuoi programmi della giornata?
it.#Do traffic jams make you change your ro: Le code ti fanno cambiare percorso o orario di partenza?
it.#Always: I plan my trips to avoid them: Sempre: organizzo gli spostamenti per evitarle
it.#How hard is it to find a parking space: Quanto è difficile trovare parcheggio nei posti dove vai?
it.#Think of the places you drive to most o: Pensa ai posti dove vai più spesso in auto.
it.#When parking is hard, what do you usual: Quando è difficile parcheggiare, cosa fai di solito?
it.#I still go, but it's slower or more str: Ci vado lo stesso, ma è più lento o più stressante
it.#I put off, avoid or cancel some trips: Rimando, evito o annullo alcuni spostamenti
it.#I go another way instead (e.g. bus, on: Mi sposto in un altro modo (ad es. autobus, a piedi)
it.#How much do charging points affect whet: Quanto contano i punti di ricarica nella scelta di usare un’auto elettrica?
it.#Not for me: my vehicle isn't electric: Non mi riguarda: il mio veicolo non è elettrico
it.#Your surroundings: Il posto in cui ti muovi
it.#When you travel by car, how much does t: Quando viaggi in auto, quanto ti disturba o ti infastidisce il rumore del traffico?
it.#When you travel by car, what do you do: Quando viaggi in auto, cosa fai quando l’aria è cattiva (gas di scarico, polvere, cattivi odori)?
it.#I notice it, but I don't change anythin: Me ne accorgo, ma non cambio nulla
it.#I protect myself, e.g. with a mask or c: Mi proteggo, ad es. con una mascherina o i finestrini chiusi
it.#I take another route or travel at anoth: Prendo un altro percorso o mi sposto in un altro orario
it.#I travel another way (e.g. by bus inste: Mi sposto in un altro modo (ad es. in autobus invece che a piedi)
it.#When you travel by car, what do you usu: Quando viaggi in auto, cosa fai di solito quando il tempo è brutto (pioggia, vento, freddo o gran caldo)?
it.#Nothing changes, I travel as usual: Non cambia niente, mi sposto come sempre
it.#It's less pleasant, but I travel the sa: È meno piacevole, ma mi sposto allo stesso modo
it.#I prepare differently or change route (: Mi preparo in modo diverso o cambio percorso (ad es. vestiti, ombrello)
it.#I travel another way (e.g. by car or bu: Mi sposto in un altro modo (ad es. in auto o autobus)
it.#When you travel by car, what do you do: Quando viaggi in auto, cosa fai quando strade, fermate o percorsi sono sporchi o mal tenuti (rifiuti, cattivi odori, vetri rotti)?
it.#I notice it, but carry on as usual: Me ne accorgo, ma vado avanti come sempre
it.#It's unpleasant, but I still go that wa: È spiacevole, ma passo lo stesso da lì
it.#I avoid some stops or stretches: Evito alcune fermate o alcuni tratti
it.#I stop using that route altogether: Smetto del tutto di usare quel percorso
it.#When you travel by car, do pleasant or: Quando viaggi in auto, l’ambiente intorno, piacevole o sgradevole, influisce su come ti senti?
it.#For example buildings, squares, how car: Per esempio edifici, piazze, quanto un luogo è curato e la sua atmosfera in generale.
it.#I notice them, but they rarely make a d: Ci faccio caso, ma raramente fanno differenza
it.#Sometimes they affect my mood: A volte influiscono sul mio umore
it.#They affect a lot how I feel on the way: Influiscono molto su come mi sento lungo la strada
it.#I sometimes choose a route because it's: A volte scelgo un percorso perché è più bello o più interessante
it.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: La tua risposta è stata registrata. Grazie per il tempo dedicato alla compilazione del questionario.
it.#<p>Comfort, delays, parking and your su:
Comfort, ritardi, parcheggio e ambiente intorno a te quando viaggi in auto.

La partecipazione è volontaria e puoi saltare qualsiasi domanda. Le tue risposte non sono collegate al tuo nome. Lasciare l'email è facoltativo; l'informativa sulla privacy di SmartUrbanity spiega come viene protetta e come vengono usate le risposte.

Scopri di più su SmartUrbanity

fr.#Compared with other ways of getting aro: À quel point la voiture est-elle confortable pour vous, par rapport aux autres moyens de se déplacer ?
fr.#When you are held up on a car trip, how: Quand vous êtes retardé lors d'un trajet en voiture, quel stress ressentez-vous ?
fr.#For example traffic jams, crashes or ro: Par exemple des embouteillages, des collisions ou des travaux.
fr.#And how much do these delays upset your: Et dans quelle mesure ces retards bousculent-ils vos projets de la journée ?
fr.#Do traffic jams make you change your ro: Les embouteillages vous font-ils changer d'itinéraire ou d'heure de départ ?
fr.#Always: I plan my trips to avoid them: Toujours : je planifie mes trajets pour les éviter
fr.#How hard is it to find a parking space: À quel point est-il difficile de trouver une place de stationnement là où vous allez ?
fr.#Think of the places you drive to most o: Pensez aux endroits où vous allez le plus souvent en voiture.
fr.#Not for me: I don't drive: Cela ne me concerne pas : je ne conduis pas
fr.#When parking is hard, what do you usual: Quand il est difficile de se garer, que faites-vous habituellement ?
fr.#It doesn't change my plans: Cela ne change pas mes projets
fr.#I still go, but it's slower or more str: J'y vais quand même, mais c'est plus long ou plus stressant
fr.#I change my route or where I go: Je change d'itinéraire ou de destination
fr.#I put off, avoid or cancel some trips: Je reporte, j'évite ou j'annule certains trajets
fr.#I go another way instead (e.g. bus, on: Je me déplace autrement (par ex. en bus, à pied)
fr.#How much do charging points affect whet: Dans quelle mesure les bornes de recharge influencent-elles votre choix d’utiliser une voiture électrique ?
fr.#Not for me: my vehicle isn't electric: Cela ne me concerne pas : mon véhicule n'est pas électrique
fr.#When you travel by car, how much does t: Lorsque vous vous déplacez en voiture, dans quelle mesure le bruit de la circulation vous dérange-t-il ?
fr.#When you travel by car, what do you do: Lorsque vous vous déplacez en voiture, que faites-vous quand l’air est mauvais (gaz d’échappement, poussière, mauvaises odeurs) ?
fr.#I notice it, but I don't change anythin: Je le remarque, mais je ne change rien
fr.#I protect myself, e.g. with a mask or c: Je me protège, par ex. avec un masque ou en fermant les fenêtres
fr.#I take another route or travel at anoth: Je prends un autre itinéraire ou je voyage à un autre moment
fr.#I travel another way (e.g. by bus inste: Je me déplace autrement (par ex. en bus plutôt qu'à pied)
fr.#When you travel by car, what do you usu: Lorsque vous vous déplacez en voiture, que faites-vous habituellement quand le temps est mauvais (pluie, vent, froid ou grande chaleur) ?
fr.#Nothing changes, I travel as usual: Rien ne change, je me déplace comme d'habitude
fr.#It's less pleasant, but I travel the sa: C'est moins agréable, mais je me déplace de la même façon
fr.#I prepare differently or change route (: Je me prépare autrement ou je change d'itinéraire (par ex. vêtements, parapluie)
fr.#I put off or skip some trips: Je reporte ou je saute certains trajets
fr.#I travel another way (e.g. by car or bu: Je me déplace autrement (par ex. en voiture ou en bus)
fr.#When you travel by car, what do you do: Lorsque vous vous déplacez en voiture, que faites-vous quand les rues, les arrêts ou les chemins sont sales ou mal entretenus (déchets, odeurs, verre brisé) ?
fr.#I notice it, but carry on as usual: Je le remarque, mais je continue comme d'habitude
fr.#It's unpleasant, but I still go that wa: C'est désagréable, mais je passe quand même par là
fr.#I avoid some stops or stretches: J'évite certains arrêts ou certains tronçons
fr.#When you travel by car, do pleasant or: Lorsque vous vous déplacez en voiture, un cadre agréable ou désagréable influence-t-il ce que vous ressentez ?
fr.#For example buildings, squares, how car: Par exemple les bâtiments, les places, l'entretien d'un lieu et son atmosphère générale.
fr.#No, I don't pay attention to them: Non, je n'y fais pas attention
fr.#I notice them, but they rarely make a d: Je les remarque, mais elles font rarement une différence
fr.#They affect a lot how I feel on the way: Elles influencent beaucoup ce que je ressens en chemin
fr.#I sometimes choose a route because it's: Je choisis parfois un itinéraire parce qu'il est plus agréable ou plus intéressant
fr.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: Votre réponse a bien été enregistrée. Merci d’avoir pris le temps de remplir ce questionnaire.
fr.#<p>Comfort, delays, parking and your su:
Le confort, les retards, le stationnement et votre environnement lorsque vous vous déplacez en voiture.

La participation est volontaire et vous pouvez passer n’importe quelle question. Vos réponses ne sont pas associées à votre nom. Indiquer votre adresse e-mail est facultatif ; les informations sur la protection des données de SmartUrbanity expliquent comment elle est protégée et comment vos réponses sont utilisées.

En savoir plus sur SmartUrbanity
